texts: On day 47 of Year 1, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
Sailsworn reported to the Council that the salt-bloom store held fourteen weeks of winter supply.
The Council issued the standard winter feather ration to the Stilllight Station.
Bevin Coombe reported to the Council that the Stilllight Lantern had remained free of wraiths.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the feather store held eight weeks of supply.
The Council issued an extra feather ration to the Stilllight Station.
The Council issued an extra feather ration to the stations of the West Row.

q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_stations_1 west_row) reads the genitive "the stations of the West Row" as spatial containment, but LocatedIn is licensed for "in / at / inside / within" only; an of-genitive routes to PartOf (member of a group) or the opaque Possession.

q2_gaps: Measure / quantity of-phrase over a bare mass ("held fourteen weeks of winter supply", "eight weeks of supply") - the instruction set names the measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") only as an exclusion from the genitive rule and gives no positive encoding, so the parse had to improvise (Measure <mass-witness> unspecified 14 week).

Ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("on day 47 of Year 1") - the Time terms assume a Month plus day-of-month, so a bare (Day 47) is indistinguishable from a day-of-month reading and there is no slot for "day N of year".

Stacked three-or-more premodifiers on one head ("the standard winter feather ration") - Compound concepts specifies fusing and modifier-genus exposure for a single modifier + head, and says nothing about which modifier(s) in a stack are exposed or whether all of them fuse.
review.notes: The two report seals are handled correctly - non-factive Experiencer holder, sealed complement, only definite typing and compound-genus atoms projected to top level - and "had remained free of wraiths" correctly gets the continuation-copular state with Still, the Of complement oblique, the flat dual-emit, and no cross-seal Before. The only structural error is the LocatedIn head on the final of-genitive.

issues.reason: Where a THING is licenses LocatedIn for containment prepositions ONLY ("in / at / inside / within"), so reading the of-genitive "the stations of the West Row" as (LocatedIn sk_stations_1 west_row) asserts a spatial containment the text never states, exactly the error the same rule bars for "on / under / beside".

gaps_confirmed: Measure/quantity of-phrase over a bare mass ("fourteen weeks of winter supply", "eight weeks of supply"): Possessive / genitive NP names the measure of-phrase ("a cup of water") only as an exclusion and gives no positive encoding, and Partitives covers proportions of a definite whole, not a quantity of an unbounded mass.

Ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("on day 47 of Year 1"): the Time terms assume (Day n) is a day-of-month under a (Month ...), so there is no slot for "day N of year N" and the atom is indistinguishable from a day-of-month reading.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for "the stations of the West Row" is the ordinary genitive of Possessive / genitive NP — (PartOf sk_stations_1 west_row) if the stations are members/components of the Row, else the opaque (Possession sk_stations_1 west_row) — so a licensed form exists and no gap follows.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's third gap (stacked premodifiers in "the standard winter feather ration") is not confirmed: Compound concepts already decides the stack mechanically — "decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop" fixes the genus at the head noun ration, and "expose the modifier iff it is an adjectival property" applied per modifier exposes standard and withholds the noun modifiers winter and feather, which is what the parse emitted. Everything else checks out: the two report seals take Experiencer holders with only definite typing and compound-genus atoms projected, and the "had remained free of wraiths" state carries Still, the Of complement, the sealed flat dual-emit and no cross-seal ordering atom.
